body:
Confirmed on our side: `@memtensor/memos-local-plugin` 2.0.21 is now published on npm (`dist-tags.latest = 2.0.21`, checked today), and it carries the V4 producer-owned message-source fix from #2519 — which is exactly the root cause this issue reported (recall messages using the retired `kind: "plugin"` wrapper instead of a producer-owned source kind under `SESSION_FORMAT_VERSION = 4`).

Two follow-ups from this thread we'll track on our side:

1. The remaining DSH peer-range gap (`>=0.1.0-rc.5 <0.2.0` in 2.0.21, so `0.2.x` bundle compatibility checks still fail) — noted as tracked in #2520 / #2541; our 0.2.x installs keep the `"snapshot"`-style local pin until that lands.
2. @chichi233's Windows Desktop trace (turn-fatal, session survives, clean session logs) is the clearest blast-radius documentation in this thread — worth folding into the release notes verification for the Windows path, as it also identifies the general anti-pattern (deciding source shape from a module constant instead of the live session) in sibling plugins.

Thanks for the fix and for keeping the issue open for the compatibility work — no further action needed from us on the original V4 rejection itself.
